Memerintah Keterangan
terjemahan ip nat yang jelas * Clears all dynamic address translation entries from the NAT translation table.
hapus terjemahan ip nat di dalamnya ip global ip lokal[di luar ip-lokal global-ip] Clear a simple dynamic translation entry containing an inside translation or both inside and outside translation.
terjemahan ip nat yang jelasprotokol di dalam ip global pelabuhan global ip lokal pelabuhan lokal[di luarip port lokal lokal global-ip port global] Clears an extended dynamic translation entry.
